articles.title: PPO: From Policy Gradients to a Working Agent
articles.description: An original visual learning path through PPO: derivations, GAE, clipping, runnable PyTorch experiments, continuous actions, diagnostics, and language models.

articles.title: PPO Begins with a Contract: Collect, Estimate, Improve
articles.description: Build a concrete mental model of the actor, critic, rollout buffer, and two clocks before opening the PPO loss.

articles.title: Policy Gradients: Why a Log Probability Times an Advantage Works
articles.description: Derive the actor gradient, work through a two-action example, and see why an unbiased baseline need not reduce variance.

articles.description: Compute advantages backward by hand, distinguish termination from truncation, and keep value targets separate from normalized actor weights.

articles.title: PPO Clipping: The Four Cases, the Geometry, and the Limits
articles.description: Derive the likelihood-ratio surrogate, connect it to TRPO, and inspect exactly when clipping removes a sample’s gradient.

articles.title: One Complete PPO Update: What Moves and What Stays Frozen
articles.description: Follow tensor shapes through collection, GAE, minibatch optimization, entropy regularization, and a KL-based stopping rule.

articles.description: Run a complete PyTorch PPO agent, reproduce three seeded experiments, and test the mathematics before trusting a learning curve.

articles.title: Continuous-Action PPO: Densities, Squashing, and Vectorized Rollouts
articles.description: Build a Gaussian actor, sum the right log probabilities, account for action transforms, and preserve trajectory boundaries in parallel environments.

articles.title: Debug PPO with Evidence: Ratios, KL, Values, and Real Evaluation
articles.description: Learn what each training metric can tell you, diagnose failure patterns, and design comparisons that separate data budgets from optimizer reuse.

articles.title: PPO for Language Models: Tokens, Rewards, and Two Different Anchors
articles.description: Apply the general algorithm to text while separating old and reference policies, handling token masks, and making the sampling distribution explicit.
